nightReady.en: It is nighttime. The encounter has a 20% chance; a quiet visit does not mean the story is broken.
nightReady.zh-CN: 当前属于夜间。相遇仍有20%概率；这次没发生新事件不代表剧情出错。

nightWaiting.en: Return at night, from 9 p.m. through 7 a.m. Travel and conversations advance time; opening menus does not.
nightWaiting.zh-CN: 请在夜间21点至次日7点之间再来。旅行与交谈会推进时间，打开菜单不会。

detail.en: Don Quixote is traveling with you. Pick him in the party roster to equip gear and choose a mastery and training scroll. Save before your next adventure.
detail.zh-CN: 堂吉诃德已同行。在队伍中选择他，穿装备、设置主专精和研习卷轴。下次冒险前记得保存。

any: 白马啸西风_陈达海加入3

title.en: The knight follows his own trail

detail.en: You chose to leave Don Quixote to his search. That choice ends this invitation; it is not a failed recruitment button. Keep your almanac, prepare your party, and explore another story.
detail.zh-CN: 你选择让堂吉诃德继续寻宝。这次邀请已经结束，并非招募按钮失效。保留诗集，整备队伍后探索其他故事。

title.en: Put your new magic to work

detail.en: Dulcinea earned 30 training points and stronger spell aptitude. Select her in Training, spend her points in Character, equip spare gear, and study Bloodthorn Bolt Scroll. Team Practice deploys only the first two party members: move her into the second slot in Party to earn scroll XP. Set her equipped mastery separately.
detail.zh-CN: 杜尔西内娅获得30培养点与法术成长。在修炼页选择她，到人物页分配点数、穿备用装备，再研习血棘飞矢卷轴。结伴练习只让队伍前两人出场：请在队伍页把她上移到第二位，参战才有卷轴经验。主专精需要单独设置。

detail.en: You found the Heroes' Almanac. Don Quixote may appear inside Windmill Warrens, with a 20% chance each visit. If he is absent, leave and return later. Inviting him costs 2 morality.
detail.zh-CN: 你已取得英雄诗集。堂吉诃德在风车地宫内每次有20%概率出现；暂未出现时可离开后再来。邀请会扣除2点道德值。

detail.en: Dulcinea did not join on this branch. Your adventure continues: prepare for two battles at Windmill Warrens. The entrance event has a 50% chance; leave and return if it does not happen. Train your current companions first if needed.
detail.zh-CN: 这条分支中杜尔西内娅没有加入，故事仍可继续。风车地宫有两场战斗；入口事件仍有50%概率，未发生时可离开后再来。吃力时先培养现有伙伴。

any: 白马啸西风_李文秀加入

title.zh-CN: 与杜尔西内娅前往风车地宫

detail.en: Dulcinea has joined. Equip her before the final battle. The entrance encounter has a 50% chance; leave and return if the ruins are quiet. Save before heading in.
detail.zh-CN: 杜尔西内娅已加入，决战前先为她整备装备。入口事件有50%概率；废墟暂时安静时可离开后再来。出发前保存。

any: 白马啸西风_李文秀出走

detail.en: The camp confrontation has a 30% chance when you travel there. Leave and return if nothing happens. Standing with Dulcinea adds 5 trust; siding with the knight subtracts 5. Recruitment needs 60 trust, so your earlier choices matter.
detail.zh-CN: 前往营地时有30%概率发生冲突。暂未发生时可离开后再来。支持杜尔西内娅增加5信任，支持骑士减少5；加入需要60信任，之前的选择仍然有效。

title.zh-CN: 入夜后再找杜尔西内娅

detail.en: Speak with her at Windrider Camp after dark. Following her leads to an ambush; keeping the peace afterward adds 5 trust, while accepting the duel subtracts 5. Save before deciding.
detail.zh-CN: 入夜后在风骑营地和她交谈。跟上她会遭遇伏击，之后息事宁人增加5信任，接受切磋减少5。选择前记得保存。

title.zh-CN: 去风骑营地认识杜尔西内娅

detail.en: Dulcinea comes from Don Quixote's world: windmills, wandering knights, and a horse with better judgment than most people. Meet her at camp. Prepare your companions before following her trail; these battles are tougher than the tutorial.
detail.zh-CN: 杜尔西内娅来自堂吉诃德的世界：风车、游侠，以及一匹比大多数人更明智的马。先到营地认识她。沿线索行动前培养队友，这些战斗比教学更难。

completeText.en: Your party is ready to explore. For a first story, meet Dulcinea at Windrider Camp. Her trail leads to Windmill Warrens. Trust, nighttime encounters and your choices matter, so save before major decisions.
completeText.zh-CN: 队伍已准备好，可以开始探索。第一条故事推荐去风骑营地认识杜尔西内娅，沿线索前往风车地宫。好感、夜间相遇和选择都会影响走向，重要决定前记得存档。

schoolNote.en: Choose a training organization, or travel independently. Round Table has a guided first training route and a companion at graduation. Its mountain pass stays closed until then. Joining starts that route immediately; signature techniques are earned later.
schoolNote.zh-CN: 可以加入组织训练，也可以独自旅行。圆桌骑士团有完整的初步训练指引，出师时会有伙伴加入；此前山道不会开放。点击加入即开始该路线，特色技艺仍需后续获取。

detail.en: Speak with Grimm. His first gift is a mastery scroll, not a demand for rent.
detail.zh-CN: 和格林交谈，领取第一份专精卷轴。他暂时不会收你房租。

detail.en: Open your adventurer's journal and equip a weapon from your bag. Your first practice blade is ready to use. Crossroads Supplies sells armor when you need it.
detail.zh-CN: 打开冒险者手册，把行囊中的武器穿上。第一把练习武器已经备好，需要护甲时可去十字镇补给铺。

detail.en: Steadfast Mastery is your first passive. Keep it equipped, then select its manual in Study. Fighting earns study XP. If the manual is already completed, continue with your learned skills or find a new guide.
detail.zh-CN: 坚毅专精是你的第一项被动专精，保持装备，再在研习区选择对应手册。实战会给予研习经验；本书已掌握时可继续使用本领，或寻找新教材。

detail.en: Ask the village instructor to practice. You can use a Welcome Elixir from Inventory first. Win the practice fight to complete this goal. If you lose, get ready and try again.
detail.zh-CN: 找村中教官练习。可先在行囊使用一份启程药剂。赢得练习战斗才能完成此目标；落败后可准备好再试。

detail.en: Ask Grimm about leaving, then accept his practical lessons. Prepare before setting out: the instructor stays in the village.
detail.zh-CN: 向格林询问出发的事，并接受实地教学。出发前先做好准备，教官会留在村中。

detail.en: Visit Crossroads Supplies. Choose one free scroll, receive five tonics, then make an actual purchase. Bring the supplies back to Grimm.
detail.zh-CN: 前往十字镇补给铺，选择一份赠送卷轴、领取五份药剂，再实际购买一件商品。随后回去向格林交差。

detail.en: Meet Eir in Healer's Vale and offer to travel together. Her missing-stoat expedition continues later; joining the party is enough for this field assignment.
detail.zh-CN: 去药师谷见埃尔，答应结伴同行。寻宠的后续探险留到以后，本章先完成招募。

detail.en: Return to Grimm's home and choose Team Practice. Both companions must take part. This goal needs a real victory; if defeated, prepare and try again.
detail.zh-CN: 回格林居所，选择结伴练习，让两位队员一起参战。这个目标需要实际获胜，落败后可准备好再挑战。

detail.en: Save on the map. Return to the title and Continue Journey to check that your companion, equipment and scroll study remain.
detail.zh-CN: 在地图上保存。回到标题后继续旅程，检查伙伴、装备和卷轴研习是否保留。
